summary: Takes an empty VS Code window or a folder without a solution to a CMSIS solution that builds, flashes and debugs, then hands over to cmsis-debug-live.
triggers: the user wants to start a new CMSIS project for a board
get_session_status says that no folder is open
stop_conditions: Ask the user to install the **Keil Studio Pack** (`Arm.keil-studio-pack`) from the Extensions view and to reload the window.
Ask, unless the request already says:
Do not guess the board from a vague name and do not pick a folder yourself.
Ask the user to answer the prompts of the Arm Tools Environment Manager in that window (download, licence; Arm Compiler 6 asks for a licence once) and to tell you when the environment is active.

When it reports that the DFP has no startup component (device support comes only from a configuration generator), tell the user, and offer a template of the pack, or `proc-add-board-layer` (`knowledge_get`) once a solution exists.
at most three times; then read `get_recent_problems` and report what the extension said.
Neither procedure in the index (`knowledge_get` fails for both): ask the user to choose the debug adapter in the CMSIS view under **Manage Solution Settings**.
Ask the user to connect the board.
When a procedure is not in the index, say so and do not improvise its steps.

extracted.title: Agent shell is not the VS Code terminal
extracted.body: The agent's shell is not the VS Code terminal: the tools the Arm Tools Environment Manager activates are on the PATH of VS Code's terminals, not on yours. Nothing in this skill depends on them.

extracted.title: Solution file exists but is not loaded
extracted.body: The solution is not loaded. Go to step 6 (open the solution in VS Code).

extracted.title: No folder is open in the window
extracted.body: No project is open in the window. Go to step 3, then step 4 with the chosen folder.
